caption: Training curves on the synthetic dataset. We refer our readers to Figure <ref> in Appendix <ref> for a visualization of the synthetic dataset.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between training accuracy and epoch number for three different training methods. The x-axis is labeled “Epoch” and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with tick marks every 50 units. The y-axis is labeled “Training Accuracy” and is a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks every 0.2 units. The first line, colored magenta and labeled “C³A<sub>b</sub> = 128/2”, begins at approximately 0.15 at Epoch 0, rises to a peak of approximately 0.95 at Epoch 40, then declines to approximately 0.83 at Epoch 400 with considerable fluctuation. The second line, colored light blue and labeled “LoRA<sub>r</sub> = 1”, starts at approximately 0.2 at Epoch 0, rises to approximately 0.85 by Epoch 300, and fluctuates between approximately 0.75 and 0.90 from Epoch 300 to 400. Finally, the third line, colored dark blue and labeled “Linear”, begins at approximately 0.45 at Epoch 0, increases to approximately 0.65 at Epoch 150, and reaches approximately 0.78 at Epoch 400, with significant fluctuations throughout its course.
